title: Magnolol as STAT3 inhibitor for treating multiple sclerosis by restricting Th17 cells.
authors: Chen, Jian-Yu; Tian, Xiao-Yun; Wei, Shan-Shan; Xu, Wen; Pan, Rong-Rong; Chen, Lin-Lin; Chen, Lang-Dong; Nan, Li-Hong; Yao-Lin; Shan-Deng; Wang, Qian-Qian; Ma, Xue-Qin; Huang, Ming-Qing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究厚朴酚作为STAT3抑制剂通过限制Th17细胞治疗多发性硬化，虽涉及STAT3蛋白与DNA结合相关的转录活性及分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作和疾病治疗，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟仅浅层应用。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an immune disease in the central nervous system (CNS) associated with Th17 cells. Moreover, STAT3 initiates Th17 cell differentiation and IL-17A expression through facilitating RORgammat in MS. Here, we reported that magnolol, isolated from Magnolia officinalis Rehd. Et Wils, was regarded as a candidate for MS treatment verified by both in vitro and in vivo studies. METHODS: In vivo, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) model in mice was employed to evaluate the alleviation of magnolol on myeloencephalitis. In vitro, FACS assay was employed to evaluate the effect of magnolol on Th17 and Treg cell differentiation and IL-17A expression; network pharmacology-based study was applied to probe the involved mechanisms; western blotting, immunocytochemistry, and luciferase reporter assay was used to further confirm the regulation of magnolol on JAK/STATs signaling pathway; surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay and molecular docking were applied to manifest affinity with STAT3 and binding sites; overexpression of STAT3 was employed to verify whether magnolol attenuates IL-17A through STAT3 signaling pathway. RESULTS: In vivo, magnolol alleviated loss of body weight and severity of EAE mice; magnolol improved lesions in spinal cords and attenuated CD45 infiltration, and serum cytokines levels; correspondingly, magnolol focused on inhibiting Th17 differentiation and IL-17A expression in splenocyte of EAE mice; moreover, magnolol selectively inhibited p-STAT3(Y705) and p-STAT4(Y693) of both CD4(+) and CD8(+) T cells in splenocyte of EAE mice. In vitro, magnolol selectively inhibited Th17 differentiation and IL-17A expression without impact on Treg cells; network pharmacology-based study revealed that magnolol perhaps diminished Th17 cell differentiation through regulating STAT family members; western blotting further confirmed that magnolol inhibited p-JAK2(Y1007) and selectively antagonized p-STAT3(Y705) and slightly decreased p-STAT4(Y693); magnolol antagonized both STAT3 nucleus location and transcription activity; magnolol had a high affinity with STAT3 and the specific binding site perhaps to be at SH2 domain; overexpression of STAT3 resulted in failed inhibition of magnolol on IL-17A. CONCLUSION: Magnolol selectively inhibited Th17 differentiation and cytokine expression through selectively blocking of STAT3 resulting in decreased the ratio of Th17/Treg cells for treating MS, suggesting that the potential of magnolol for treating MS as novel STAT3 inhibitor.
abstract_zh: 目的：多发性硬化症（MS）是一种与Th17细胞相关的中枢神经系统（CNS）免疫疾病。此外，STAT3通过促进RORgammat在MS中启动Th17细胞分化和IL-17A表达。在此，我们报道了从厚朴（Magnolia officinalis Rehd. Et Wils）中分离出的厚朴酚（magnolol），经体外和体内研究验证，被视为MS治疗的候选药物。方法：在体内，采用小鼠实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）模型评估厚朴酚对脑脊髓炎的缓解作用。在体外，采用FACS检测评估厚朴酚对Th17和Treg细胞分化及IL-17A表达的影响；基于网络药理学的研究用于探讨其涉及机制；采用western blotting、免疫细胞化学和荧光素酶报告基因检测进一步确认厚朴酚对JAK/STATs信号通路的调控；采用表面等离子体共振（SPR）检测和分子对接以展示其与STAT3的亲和力及结合位点；通过STAT3过表达验证厚朴酚是否通过STAT3信号通路减弱IL-17A。结果：在体内，厚朴酚减轻了EAE小鼠的体重下降和疾病严重程度；厚朴酚改善了脊髓病变并减少了CD45浸润及血清细胞因子水平；相应地，厚朴酚主要抑制EAE小鼠脾细胞中Th17分化和IL-17A表达；此外，厚朴酚选择性抑制EAE小鼠脾细胞中CD4(+)和CD8(+) T细胞的p-STAT3(Y705)和p-STAT4(Y693)。在体外，厚朴酚选择性抑制Th17分化和IL-17A表达，而不影响Treg细胞；基于网络药理学的研究揭示，厚朴酚可能通过调控STAT家族成员减少Th17细胞分化；western blotting进一步确认，厚朴酚抑制p-JAK2(Y1007)并选择性拮抗p-STAT3(Y705)，且轻微降低p-STAT4(Y693)；厚朴酚拮抗STAT3核定位和转录活性；厚朴酚与STAT3具有高亲和力，其特异性结合位点可能在SH2结构域；STAT3过表达导致厚朴酚对IL-17A的抑制作用失效。结论：厚朴酚通过选择性阻断STAT3，选择性抑制Th17分化和细胞因子表达，从而降低Th17/Treg细胞比例以治疗MS，提示厚朴酚作为新型STAT3抑制剂治疗MS的潜力。
